import json

path = "/home/oni/.claude/projects/-home-oni-jaeger-mcp-bench-harness/a3e2a4c9-41d8-4ca1-9e70-7f214f0c659b/tool-results/mcp-jaeger-bench-get_trace_data-1786339135553.txt"
with open(path) as f:
    data = json.load(f)

traces = data["data"]
print("num traces:", len(traces))

results = []
for t in traces:
    spans = t["spans"]
    starts = [s["startTime"] for s in spans]
    ends = [s["startTime"] + s["duration"] for s in spans]
    total_dur = max(ends) - min(starts)
    services = set()
    procs = t.get("processes", {})
    for pid, p in procs.items():
        services.add(p.get("serviceName"))
    results.append((total_dur, t["traceID"], len(spans), services))

results.sort(reverse=True, key=lambda x: x[0])
for r in results[:5]:
    print(r[0], r[1], "spans:", r[2], "services:", sorted(r[3]))
